mapper.select: SELECT source_id, investigation_id, aggregate_version, contract_version, source_json, source_sha256, document_sha256, committed_at FROM authority_diagnosis_source WHERE investigation_id = #{investigationId}

SELECT intent_id, investigation_id, aggregate_sequence, event_type, source_id, source_sha256, topic_name, idempotency_key, schema_version, canonical_content, canonical_sha256, status, attempt_count, eligible_at, lease_expires_at, lease_owner, lease_token, last_error_code, delivered_at, created_at, updated_at FROM authority_publication_intent WHERE investigation_id = #{investigationId}

SELECT intent_id, investigation_id, aggregate_sequence, event_type, source_id, source_sha256, topic_name, idempotency_key, schema_version, canonical_content, canonical_sha256, status, attempt_count, eligible_at, lease_expires_at, lease_owner, lease_token, last_error_code, delivered_at, created_at, updated_at FROM authority_publication_intent WHERE intent_id = #{intentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE authority_publication_intent SET status='PENDING', attempt_count=0, eligible_at=#{now}, lease_owner=NULL, lease_token=NULL, lease_expires_at=NULL, last_error_code=NULL, delivered_at=NULL, updated_at=#{now} WHERE intent_id=#{intentId} AND status='DEAD'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO authority_publication_attempt (intent_id, attempt_number, transport, outcome, error_code, created_at) VALUES (#{intentId}, #{attemptNumber}, #{transport}, #{outcome}, #{errorCode}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM authority_publication_intent WHERE status = #{status}
